verdict.rationale: Cekura ingests production calls as CallLogs and evaluates metrics on them. Its homepage claims that issues flagged in production are reproduced in simulation, which loosely maps to turning production traces into offline test cases. There are no docs on curating or versioning a dataset from selected production calls, or on re-running offline evals against such a set. A community question asks whether linking simulations back to production sessions is still manual. Missing for 10: documented dataset curation from production traces, a workflow for running offline evaluations against curated production datasets, dataset versioning/management, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Cekura flags issues → reproduces in simulation → suggests fixes automatically.
Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
